interface.signature: def search(txt: str, pat: str) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: txt and pat must be strings.
Length of txt must be between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).
Length of pat must be at least 1 and strictly less than length of txt.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= len(txt) - len(pat) + 1 for idx in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned indices must be valid 1-based starting positions for pat in txt.

postconditions.expression: all(txt[idx-1:idx-1+len(pat)] == pat for idx in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every returned index must correspond to a valid occurrence of pat in txt.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(txt) - len(pat) + 2) if txt[i-1:i-1+len(pat)] == pat)
postconditions.description: The returned list must contain exactly all valid 1-based starting indices of pat in txt.
